275286946.description:
Parker Pen Company
Stainless Steel Pen and Pencil Set
Jotter Series, Vintage
This Parker Jotter writing set includes a matching ballpoint pen and mechanical pencil, both featuring the classic brushed stainless steel finish and signature arrow clips. Introduced in 1954, the Jotter series became an icon of functional Mid-Century design, praised for its streamlined profile and reliable push-button mechanism. This set is presented in its original black and white pinstriped Parker branding box.
Stainless steel barrel construction with polished chrome-tone accents
Signature Parker arrow pocket clips and top-actuated push-button mechanisms
Set includes one ballpoint pen and one mechanical pencil with original display box
Parker and Jotter branding visible on both the instruments and the packaging
Condition:
Good vintage condition. Both writing instruments appear structurally sound with no significant dents or scratches visible on the metal barrels. The clips are tight and aligned. The push-button mechanisms are intact. The original box shows light shelf wear and minor scuffing to the exterior surfaces, but remains structurally complete and holds the pieces securely.

275849807.description:
Hewlett-Packard (HP)
dvd1270e LightScribe Multiformat DVD Writer
Manufactured July 2010
This HP external optical drive represents a significant era in consumer media technology, featuring the now-legacy LightScribe system. LightScribe technology allowed users to etch custom, silkscreen-quality labels directly onto the top surface of compatible discs using the drive's internal laser. As a multiformat recorder, this unit supports a wide array of optical media including DVDR DL and CD-RW, offering robust data archiving and media playback capabilities for legacy desktop and laptop systems.
Model: HP dvd1270e (dvd1270 series)
Interface: USB connectivity with integrated rear power toggle switch
Technology: LightScribe direct disc labeling and Multi Recorder R DL support
Manufacture Date: Verified July 2010 via original manufacturer serial label
Condition:
Very good physical condition. The matte black and silver-tone housing shows only minor surface scuffs consistent with light handling. The front bezel markings and brand icons remain sharp and clear. The disc tray door and rear ports appear well-maintained. Power adapter and USB cables are not included.
